metadata.title: Occupational Health and Safety Platform Deployment Channels
metadata.description: Product bricks are deployed to the Kitry web application (workforce and surveillance, occupational health consultation, medical records, workplace safety, accidents and occupational diseases, monitoring and analytics, administration), to the employee and manager portals and responsive field safety reporting, to integrations (HRIS synchronisation, SSO identity providers, Goodflag e-signature, Vonage telehealth, Cegedim SMS, measurement devices, national reporting connectors), to the shared and dedicated HDS/ISO 27001 SaaS hosting environments inside the EEA, and to internal operations (implementation and migration workspace, regulatory content back office, support desk). Interfaces in French, Dutch and English; sector pre-configurations for industry, chemicals and pharma, healthcare facilities, universities and research, public sector, financial services, transport and logistics, and services. Each deployed brick records the products that use it.

channels.description: The Kitry browser application for health, safety, accidents, analytics and administration, one sub-channel per functional area, with role-based interfaces for physicians, nurses, HSE managers, prevention advisers, HR administrators and service coordinators. No installation; French, Dutch and English interfaces.
Where the workforce register, sites and workstations, exposure profiles and surveillance rules are maintained and convocations and appointment slots are planned per physician and nurse.
